overall_goal: Perform secondary kitchen tasks including shaping pizza dough, turning off appliances, and setting the table for serving

goals.description: Dry hands and lid with a cloth
goals.rationale: The person uses a cloth to dry the lid and their hands before putting the cloth away.

goals.description: Shape and cover the pizza dough
goals.rationale: The person uncovers the resting pizza dough, uses scrapers to flip and fold it, shapes it into a round ball, and covers it again with the plastic box.

goals.description: Turn off the hob and cover the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person turns off the kitchen hob, places a glass lid on the frying pan, and subsequently turns off the extractor fan and light.

goals.description: Take the baked kale out of the oven
goals.rationale: The person puts on oven mitts, opens the oven, turns it off, removes the baking tray with kale, shakes it, places it on the hob, and takes off the mitts.
The person arranges items on the table, including centering the omelette plate, moving cutlery, a tissue box, and a glass, and placing a cork pot stand.

goals.description: Serve the baked kale on the table
goals.rationale: The person puts the oven mitts back on, carries the hot baking tray of kale to the table, places it on the cork stand, adjusts nearby items, and hangs up the mitts.

goals.description: Get a spoon for the table
goals.rationale: The person opens a cupboard, retrieves a spoon from the cutlery tray, closes the cupboard, and places the spoon on the table.
